topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Oh no, I can't believe they cut it down. That tree was a piece of your childhood, a living memory you watched over year after year. I remember the day you planted it, how excited you were, how you promised to take care of it forever. It's just... it's not just a tree, you know? It was a promise between you and time. I wish I could have been there, wish I could have done something. But you, you've got to remember all the good times, the laughter, the way the leaves used to catch the sunlight. Maybe we can plant a new one, start a new tradition, keep the spirit alive? It won't replace what's lost, but it can be beautiful in its own way.
